summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  ### What I found on read-only audit I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `modules/watchlist/schema.ts` → SQLite, plus the auth path in `db/auth.ts` and `server.ts`.  On paper, the chain looks correctly scoped: - `watchlists.user_id` and ownership checks (`and(eq(watchlists.id, id), eq(watchlists.user_id, userId))`) exist on every read/write handler. - The client uses `credentials: "include"` on every request and has no localStorage/anonymous fallback for watchli
